name: serial-console
description: By Stefan Brunner. Let Claude work any device through its serial console: Juniper and Cisco routers and switches, IoT gateways, alarm and control panels, instruments and microcontrollers, and CAT and CI-V radios and antenna rotators, in raw, ANSI or VT100 mode.

interface.longDescription:
By Stefan Brunner. Let Claude work any device through its serial console: Juniper and Cisco routers and switches, IoT gateways, alarm and control panels, instruments and microcontrollers, and CAT and CI-V radios and antenna rotators, in raw, ANSI or VT100 mode.

The server runs on your own computer and opens its serial ports, so the plugin needs the ChatGPT desktop app.
defaultPrompt: List my serial ports and connect to the switch
Show the interfaces on this Junos device
Read the frequency from my radio over CAT
